QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] The Royal Cook
QuestInfo.0: Chef Michelin wants to ask you a favor. Find him at the Kritias Inn.
QuestInfo.1: Michelin is struggling to find his usual ingredients. He wants some recipes that rely on more common ingredients.\r\nTalk to #bHirrel#k.
QuestInfo.2: You went to Hirrel to get a new cookbook for Michelin.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  38,293,488
Can proceed to [Kritias] Hungry for Words

0.0: Hello, morsel! I am Michelin, the mightiest cook, and I have a job for you!
0.1: I escaped the castle with my life, but all of my ingredients were left to fend for themselves. I want to make my famous fish-finger souffle, but all of the ingredients here are utterly bizarre. What is a 'car-rot,' anyway?
0.2: They say there's a famous cookbook called #b#r100 Palace Dishes#n#k. The recipes inside are supposed to make meals fit for a king using ingredients barely fit for a commoner!
0.3: #bHirrel#k over at town hall is supposed to be some sort of book-genius. I bet he's hiding that book somewhere! Get it for me so I can make munchies!

yes.0: Marvelous! #bHirrel#k is probably outside town hall!

no.0: Don't you... don't you like munchies?\r\nFine. I'll just have to bake a #h0# pie, instead!

1.0: Did you ever find out where the princess was filed away?

npc.0: No, no, get the book from Hirrel, not me! You adventurer types sure do confuse easily, don't you?
